title: High-agency Ring Flight (cruise, boost, brake-to-hover)
description:
Purpose: High-agency ring-propelled flight with controlled transition from ground/hover, cruise and boost modes, altitude or pitch assist, comfort banking assist, and quick stop back to Hover. Includes auto-avoid small collisions, soft bounce, and out-of-bounds auto-hover return.

Controls (Quest 3 — verbatim):
- Left Thumbstick: directional thrust (per selected locomotion frame; head- or controller-relative).
- Left Thumbstick Click: Boost modifier in flight.
- Right Thumbstick: snap or smooth turn; in flight, up/down adjusts altitude or pitch assist depending on mode.
- A Button: Double-tap to toggle hover or flight where allowed.
- B Button: Cancel / dismiss active preview / quick evade burst.

Params (params_json):
- cruise_max_speed_mps (float, default 6.0)
- boost_multiplier (float, default 1.6)
- accel_tau_s (float, default 0.20)
- decel_tau_s (float, default 0.25)
- altitude_rate_mps (float, default 2.0)
- bank_assist (bool, default true)
- comfort_vignette_on_boost (bool, default true)
- oob_return_delay_s (float, default 1.0)
- collision_soft_bounce_coeff (float, default 0.35)
- no_fly_volumes_tag (string, default "no_fly")

Behaviour:
1) Enter flight when double-tap A while not in a no-fly volume. Sets CLocomotionMode=Flight; clears hover.
2) Per frame, read Left Stick to compute thrust vector in currently selected reference frame (head or controller). Accel/decel smoothly to cruise_max_speed_mps; if LStick Click held, multiply by boost_multiplier and, if comfort_vignette_on_boost, raise vignette per locomotion_options_ui.
3) Right Stick vertical:
   - If altitude assist enabled, adjust vertical velocity by altitude_rate_mps scaled by input.
   - Else if pitch assist enabled, adjust camera rig pitch blend while clamping to comfort limits (no camera roll).
4) B Button quick-evade:
   - Apply a short lateral impulse opposite recent incoming fire vector if available; otherwise lateral to HMD right. Short haptic and brief vignette pulse.
5) Flight->Hover brake:
   - On A double-tap or on Left Stick release with brake intent, ease velocity to 0 and set hover_mode_mechanic active immediately.
6) Collisions/out-of-bounds:
   - Perform ray or shape cast ahead; apply soft avoidance or bounce with collision_soft_bounce_coeff.
   - Entering out-of-bounds triggers auto-hover return: lerp position back to last safe point in oob_return_delay_s while showing an on-HUD warning.

Components:
- Reads: CInput, CTransform, CPhysics (collision), CComfortState, scene bounds, no-fly trigger tags.
- Writes: CLocomotionMode, CLocomotionVelocity, CFlightState (cruise/boost), CAimStabilizer (optional mild stabilization in flight), CHapticsEvent.

Comfort rules:
- No camera roll; stabilized horizon option; speed-scaled vignette on boost; gentle speed ramps; instant brake into hover.

Acceptance hooks:
- Satisfies test_flight_boost_and_brake in launch_platform and open_orbital_battlefield.

Integration and depends_on:
- Depends on hover_mode_mechanic to transition to Hover on brake.
- Reads vignette prefs from locomotion_options_ui ComfortBus.
- Uses haptics_manager for boost engage hum and evade burst patterns.

Assets/scenes:
- Visual trail hooks will use construct_energy_vfx_core for green trails.
- Active in launch_platform, open_orbital_battlefield, zero_g_flight_gauntlet.

Suggested file split: flight_system_register.cpp, flight_system_controls.cpp, flight_system_physics.cpp, flight_system_comfort.cpp.
